error.start.title: LectureFlow could not start
error.start.body: The background service did not start. You can try again; if it keeps happening, the logs show the reason.
error.crash.title: The background service stopped unexpectedly
error.crash.body: Unfinished tasks are kept and continue from where they stopped after a restart.
error.page.title: The page could not be loaded
error.page.body: The background service is still running. You can load the page again.
error.data_dir.title: The data folder cannot be reached
error.data_dir.body: LectureFlow keeps its data in {path}, which cannot be reached now. If it is on an external drive, connect the drive and try again.
error.location.title: The data folder setting cannot be read
error.location.body: The contents of {path} are not recognised. So as not to show an empty library, LectureFlow did not switch to the default location. Correct or delete this file, then try again; without it the default location {default} is used.
reason.timeout: The background service did not respond within 30 seconds.
reason.not_found: The background service program was not found: {path}
reason.spawn_failed: The background service program could not be run ({code}): {path}
reason.exit_code: The background service exited with code {code}.
reason.port: Several ports in a row could not be used.
reason.token_rejected: The background service rejected the access token.
reason.bad_mode: The background service is not running in desktop mode.
reason.restart_loop: The background service kept asking to be restarted.
reason.unwritable: The data folder could not be created: {path}
close.detail: If they continue in the background, you will be notified when they finish. Quitting stops them; they continue from where they stopped the next time you open LectureFlow.
close.remember: Remember my choice (you can change it in Settings)
background.title: LectureFlow is working in the background
background.body.win32: Open it again from the icon in the notification area.
background.body.darwin: Open it again from the Dock.
restore.detail: LectureFlow will use the default location {path}. location.json is renamed to {backup} (with a date added if that name is taken); no data is deleted, and renaming the file back restores the old setting.
debug.refused.title: LectureFlow does not start with debugging options
debug.refused.body: LectureFlow was started with {switches}. These options would let other programs control the window, so LectureFlow closes. Start it again from its shortcut.
